0022600146.text: The Portland Trail Blazers, 3-0 and on a three-game winning streak, host the Memphis Grizzlies, who are 4-0 with four straight wins, in the fourth game of the 2026-27 season for Portland. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Memphis has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1.
